Title: Rules Question: Stunt Cycle v. First Strike Damage

Messages.Author: Preston
Messages.Body:
Ok, let's say that Hector Sosa is coming to bleed. Ferox blocks, sets
range to long with High Ground, and collpases the arches of Hector's
monkey ass. If Hector's strike was Stunt Cycle, can prevent damage from
the First Strike Collapse damage even though his strike has not yet
resolved?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Stunt Cycle's damage prevention only works against simultaneously-resolving
damage. It even reminds you of this with "during this strike resolution".
